title: Data-proximal null-space networks for inverse problems: companion code
description:
Research code accompanying the paper Data-proximal null-space networks for inverse problems by Jürgen Frikel, Simon Göppel and Markus Haltmeier. Data-proximal networks extend null-space networks by learned corrections whose additional change of the predicted data is explicitly controlled.

The repository contains the implementation of the synthetic limited-angle computed tomography study: ellipse phantom generation, the discrete Radon operator and the numerical row-space projection, Tikhonov and total-variation initializations, the residual (RES), null-space (NSN) and data-proximal (DP1, DP2) networks, Float64 training with checkpointing, the frozen evaluator, the public inference entry point for published checkpoints, and the compact scientific export from which the paper tables and figures are regenerated with scripts/reproduce_paper.py. Trained weights, the row-space basis, the operator and the sample data will be published as separate data records upon acceptance of the article.
